stem_book: The entropy change involved in the isothermal reversible expansion of 2 moles of an ideal gas from a volume of 10 dm³ to a volume of 100 dm³ at 27°C is: (a) 38.3 J K⁻¹ (b) 35.8 J K⁻¹ (c) 32.3 J K⁻¹ (d) 42.3 J K⁻¹
reason: Options printed in J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ but 38.3 is the total for 2 mol (per mole would be 19.1); units corrected to J K⁻¹.
